newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain new job contracts up 17.04 pct y/y in June.
newsitem.headline: Spain new job contracts up 17.04 pct y/y in June.

text.p: Spain's Labour Ministry said on Thursday the number of new job contracts rose 17.04 percent year on year in June to 819,548.
Among them 69,544 were permanent contracts, the ministry said in a statement.
It stressed that in June, the first month after the final approval of a new labour reform, the 31,881 fall in the jobless total was higher than the average of the last 15 years.
The unemployment rate fell in June to 13.06 percent from 13.26 percent in May and 14.15 percent in June 1996.
